bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: STATIC arithmetic over the committed complete-EBPW ledger. It does not argue the bar is wrong and does not move it. It states which term has to change, so that effort is not spent on a lever whose entire remaining range cannot reach the threshold.
finding: FLASH_COMPLETE_EBPW_LE_1 is the only numeric acceptance spec in the 83-gate catalog and it cannot be reached by MLP density at any value. With the ENTIRE MLP at zero bytes -- a bound no compression scheme can beat -- complete_ebpw is still 1.545, above the threshold of 1. The attention+deltanet term alone, at Q4, is 1.55x the whole byte budget. Driving MLP density from 2.50 to 0.50 bpw moves the total only 3.136 -> 2.10. The bar needs attention/deltanet below Q4 before any MLP result can matter.

second_lever_required.note: currently Q4; the bar needs it below Q4 before MLP density matters
